# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- When implementing changes, think carefully before coding. Prefer simplicity first, make surgical changes only, and execute goal-driven with clear success criteria and verification.
- Conduct a careful design review before implementation and ensure that changes are thoroughly thought through before coding.
- Review proposed changes before any code modifications are made.
- Do not change code until explicitly asked.
- Verify changes in the running app and correct claims of success if issues persist; avoid assuming a fix without runtime verification.
